rule_applied: No 'verified' label without successful prediction, failed prediction, and replayable evidence (amended CONSTITUTION.md rule).

audit_of_current_verification_claims.assessment: MISLABELED under the amended rule. The label is applied whenever CoreAdapter.run_pipeline() returns without raising — that is absence-of-crash, not verification. There is no recorded successful prediction, no recorded failed prediction, and no replay mechanism behind this label. Recommend downgrading to 'integrated' until a real predict -> observe -> reconcile cycle exists and is logged to a working ledger.

structural_gap: The 'verified' tier as amended cannot be honestly claimed by anything in this repo right now, because data/ledger/predictions.jsonl -- the only mechanism for recording prediction outcomes -- is corrupted (see FAILURES.md, item F-005) and no code path currently reads a prediction, waits for an outcome, and reconciles pass/fail. Until that loop exists and is replayable, every 'verified' stamp in this system is aspirational, not evidenced, regardless of which endpoint it's attached to.
recommendation: Do not use the 'verified' label anywhere in the codebase until: (1) predictions.jsonl is regenerated and readable, (2) at least one prediction has a recorded outcome (pass or fail), (3) that outcome is replayable from the ledger alone. Until then, cap all labels at 'integrated'.
